English: The world currently faces two ongoing devastating pandemics.

English: These are the new severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2/coronavirus disease 2019 (SARS-CoV-2/COVID-19) and the prior human immunodeficiency virus/acquired immune deficiency syndrome (HIV/AIDS) pandemics.
Luganda: Muno mulimu akawuka akapya akakwata omussizo aka coronavirus 2/obulwadde bwa coronavirus 2019 (SARS-CoV-2/COVID-19) n’akawuka akaasangibwawo aka human immunodeficiency virus/acquired immune deficiency syndrome (HIV/AIDS).
Yoruba: Àwọn àjàkáyé aàrùn náà ni àìsàn ògidì èémí tó níṣẹ pẹ̀lú àpapọ̀ onírúurú àmì aàrùn kòró 2/ aàrùn kòró 2019 (SARS-CoV2/COVID-19) àti kòkòrò ajẹmọ́ HIV tí ó máa ń fa ìdínkù àjẹsára/ aàrùn ìṣọdọle àjẹsára (HIV/AIDS).
Zulu: Lezi izifo ezintsha zokuphefumula kanzima 2/nokhuvethe lwa-2019 (SARS-CoV-2/COVID-19) nempathamhlaba yangaphambilini yesandulela ngculaza nengculaza (HIV/AIDS).
Hausa: Waɗannan su ne sabbin cututtukan ƙwayar cuta na numfashi na coronavirus 2/cutar coronavirus 2019 (SARS-CoV-2/COVID-19) da ƙwayar cuta mai karya garkuwan jikin ɗan’adam/qanjamau (HIV/AIDS).
Northern Sotho: Tše ke mauba a maswaotwetši a maswa a go amana le mohemo o šoro wa go se alafege wa coronavirus 2/bolwetši bja coronavirus bja 2019 (SARS-CoV-2/COVID-19) le baerase ya peleng ya go fokodiša mašole a mmele go šoma/leswaotwetši la go palediša mašole a mmele go šoma (HIV/AIDS).
Amharic: እነዚህም፣ አዲሱ ከባድ አጣዳፊ የመተንፈሻ አካላት ድምረ ህመም ኮሮና ቫይረስ 2/የኮሮና ቫይረስ በሽታ 2019 (ሳርስ-ኮቫ-2/ ኮቪድ-19) እና የበፊቱ ሂዩማን ኢሚዮኖ  ዴፊሸንሲ ቫይረስ/ አኳየርድ ኢሚዩን ዴፊሸንሲ ድምረ ህመም (ኤችአይቪ/ኤድስ) ወረርሽኞች ናቸው፡፡

English: The literature regarding the confluence of these global plagues expands at pace.
Luganda: Ebiwandiiko ebikwata ku kwegatta kwa nawookeera ono abuutikidde ensi byeyongerera ku misinde.
Yoruba: Àwọn àkọsílẹ̀ nípa ìbásepọ̀ àwọn aàrùn àjàkayé yìí gbòòrò si.
Zulu: Imibhalo ngokuhlangana kwalezi zifo ezibhubhisayo iya ngokuya iyanda.
Hausa: Rubuce-rubuce game da haɗuwar waɗannan annoba ta duniya suna faɗaɗa cikin sauri.
Northern Sotho: Dingwalo mabapi le magahlano a masetlapelo a a lefase di oketšega ka lebelo.
Amharic: የእነዚህን አለም  አቀፋዊ መቅሰፍቶች ውህደት የሚመለከቱ ጽሁፎች በፍጥነት እየተስፋፉ ይገኛሉ፡፡

English: A systematic search of the literature considering COVID-19 and HIV co-infection was performed.
Luganda: Ebiwandiiko ebikwata ku kufuna COVID-19 ne HIV byanoonyezebwa.
Yoruba: Ṣíse ètò wíwá àwọn àkọsílẹ̀ tó níṣe pẹ̀lú ìkóràn-oníbejì COVID-19 àti HIV.
Zulu: Kwenziwe ukubhekwa kwemibhalo ebheka ukuphathwa i-COVID-19 ne-HIV kanyekanye.
Hausa: An yi tsararren binciken kan wallafe-wallafen da aka yi kan kamuwa da COVID-19 da cutar HIV.
Northern Sotho: Go tšwile lesolo leo le beakantšwego la go nyakana le dingwalo tše di amanago le COVID-19 le phetetšano ya HIV.
Amharic: ኮቪድ-19 እና ኤችአይቪ የጋራ-ኢንፌክሽንን አስመልክተው ያሉ ጽሁፎች ዙሪያ ስልታዊ ፍለጋ ተካሂዷል፡፡

English: After five months, from the beginning of the COVID-19 pandemic, there were at least thirty-five studies reported from thirteen countries.
Luganda: Oluvannyuma lw’emyezi etaano, okuva nawookeera wa COVID-19 lwe yatandika, waaliwo okunoonyereza kwa mirundi waakiri asatu mw’etaano okwali kukoleddwa okuva mu mawanga kkumi n’asatu.
Yoruba: Lẹ́yìn oṣù márùn-ún tí àjàkáyé aàrùn COVID-19 ti bẹ̀rẹ̀, ó kéré tán ìwádìí ìjìnlè márùn-ún-dín-lógójì ni orílẹ̀-èdè mẹ́tàlá ti jábọ̀.
Zulu: Emva kwezinyanga ezinhlanu, kusukela ekuqaleni kwe-COVID-19, bekunocwaningo olungamashumi amathathu nanhlanu olubikwe emazweni ayishumi nantathu.
Hausa: Bayan watanni biyar, daga farkon cutar ta COVID-19, an sami aƙalla bincike talatin da biyar da aka ruwaito daga ƙasashe goma sha uku.
Northern Sotho: Morago ga dikgwedi tše hlano, go tloga mola leuba la COVID-19 le thomago, go bile le dinyakišišo tše e ka bago tše masometharohlano tše di begilwego go tšwa dinageng tše lesometharo.
Amharic: የኮቪድ-19 ወረርሽኝ ከጀመረ ከ አምስት ወሮች  በኋላ ቢያንስ ከ አስራ ሶስት ሃገሮች ሰላሳ አምስት ጥናቶች ሪፖርት ተደርገው ነበር፡፡

English: These ranged from individual case reports and series to cohort studies.
Luganda: Muno mwalimu alipoota ku bantu kinnoomu n’okunoonyereza okukolebwa ku bibinja by’abantu okumala ekiseera.
Yoruba: Èyí jẹ́ yálà ìjábọ̀ iṣẹ́ tí ènìyàn kọ̀ọ̀kan tàbí àjọṣepọ̀ iṣẹ́ lọ́kanòjọ̀kan.
Zulu: Beluqala ngezehlakalo zabantu ngabodwana nezamaqoqo.
Hausa: Waɗannan sun fito ne daga rahotannin na musamman da nazarin tsarin bincike mai gudana da yawa.
Northern Sotho: Tšona di be di fapana go tloga ka dipego tša malwetši le ditatelano tša dinyakišišo tša sehlopha.
Amharic: እነዚህም ጥናቶች ከተናጥል የጉዳይ ሪፖርቶች እስከ ተከታታይ እና ጥምር ጥናቶች ድረስ አካተዋል፡፡

English: Based on studies that could be extrapolated to the general population, co-infected individuals with suppressed HIV viral loads did not have disproportionate COVID-19 sickness and death.
Luganda: Okusinziira ku kunoonyereza okulimu ebizuuliddwa ebisobola okukwata ku bantu bonna, abantu abalina HIV ng’akawuka ka HIV kakendedde COVID-19 teyabalwaza oba okubatta mu ngeri ey’enjawulo.
Yoruba: Gẹ́gẹ́ bí i ìwádìí ìjìnlẹ̀ tí ó wà fún gbogbogbò, àwọn tó ní ìkóràn níbejì àwọn aàrùn yìí pẹ̀lú àwọn òǹkà kòkòrò HIV kò ní àpọ̀jù aàrùn àti ikú COVID-19.
Zulu: Kususelwe ocwaningweni olungandiselwa ebantwini bonke, abaphethwe i-HIV enemmithamo yegciwane ecindezelekile ababanga nokuguliswa nokubulawa i-COVID-19 okungalingani kakhulu.
Hausa: Dangane da binciken da za a iya keɓancewa ga yawan jama'a, mutanen da suke da ragaggen ƙwayar cutar HIV ba sa samun rashin lafiyar COVID-19 ko mutuwa na daban daga sauran mutane.
Northern Sotho: Go lebeletšwe dinyakišišo tše di ka katološetšwa go bakgathatema ka kakaretšo, batho bao ba fetetšanego bao ba nago le kelo ye e fokotšegilego ya morwalo wa HIV ga se ba ba le bolwetši bja COVID-19 bjo bo sa lekanyetšwego le lehu.
Amharic: በመላው ህብረተሰብ ላይ ሊተገበሩ በሚችሉ ጥናቶች መሰረት፣ የተጨቆነ የኤችአይቪ ቫይረስ ጭነት ያሏቸው እና የጋራ-ኢንፌክሽን ተጠቂ የሆኑ ግለሰቦች ያልተመጣጠነ የኮቪድ-19 ህመም እና ሞት አላጋጠማቸውም፡፡

English: At least four patients, newly diagnosed with HIV recovered from COVID-19.
Luganda: Waakiri abalwadde bana, abaalinga baakazuulibwamu HIV baawona COVID-19.
Yoruba: Ó kere tán, aláìsàn HIV mẹ́rin ni wọ́n bọ̀sípò látàrí aàrùn COVID-19.
Zulu: Okungenani ziguli ezine, ezisanda kuthola ukuthi zine-HIV zisindile kwi-COVID-19.
Hausa: Aƙalla marasa lafiya huɗu, sabbin kamuwa da cutar HIV sun murmure daga cutar COVID-19.
Northern Sotho: Ka balwetši bao e ka bago ba bane, bao ba phekotšwego moragorago gwa hwetšwa ba na le HIV bao ba phologile go COVID-19.

English: Current evidence suggests that co-infected patients should be treated like the general population.
Luganda: Obukakafu obuggya bulaga nti abalwadde abalina obuwuka buno bwombi basaana okujjanjabwa ng’abantu abalala bonna.
Yoruba: Ẹ̀rí tuntun dábàá pé kí wọ́n máa ṣe sí àwọn tó ní ìkóràn àwọn aàrùn méjéèjì yìí gẹ́gẹ́ bí wọ́n ṣe ń ṣe sí àwọn ènìyàn yòókù.
Zulu: Ubufakazi bamanje bukhomba ukuthi iziguli eziphethwe yilezi zifo zombili kumele ziphathwe njengabo bonke abantu.
Hausa: Bayanai na yanzu sun nuna cewa ya kamata a kula da marasa lafiya da suka kamu da cutar kamar sauran jama'a.
Northern Sotho: Bohlatse bja bjale bo šišinya gore balwetši bao ba fetetšanago ba swanetše go swarwa go swana le setšhaba ka moka.
Amharic: አሁን ያለው መረጃ እንደሚያመለክተው የጋራ- ኢንፌክሽን ተማማዊች ልክ እንደ ሰፊው ህብረተሰብ መታከም አለባቸው፡፡

English: This ongoing living systematic evidence map of contemporary primary SARS-CoV-2 and HIV co-infection research provides a platform for researchers, policy makers, clinicians and others to more quickly discover and build relevant insights.
Luganda: Okunoonyereza kuno okukyagenda mu maaso nga kukwata ku bukakafu ku kufuna akawuka ka SARS-CoV-2 ne HIV kusobozesa abanoonyereza, abakulembeze, abasawo, n’abalala okuzuula n’okuteekateeka eky’okukola mu bwangu.
Yoruba: Ètò èrí máápù ìwádìí ìjìnlẹ̀ lórí ìbẹ̀rẹ̀pẹ̀pẹ̀ àwọn aàrùn ìkóràn-oníbejì SARS-CoV-2 àti HIV fún àwọn aṣèwádìí, aṣòfin, aṣètójú àti àwọn mìíràn ní ààyè à ti ṣe àwárí ní kíakía àti láti wá òye tó jẹmọ ìwádìí yìí.
Zulu: Lolu hlahlondlela oluqhubekayo lohlelo locwaningo lwe- SARS-CoV-2 ehambisana ne-HIV lwesimanje luhlinzeka abacwaningi, abakhi bemithetho, abahlengi nabanye ngendlela yokuthola nokwakha imiqondo efanelekile.
Hausa: Wannan taswirar shaida na rayuwa mai gudana na zamani na farko na SARS-CoV-2 da binciken haɗin ƙwiwar cutarr HIV yana ba da dandamali ga masu bincike, masu tsara manufofi, likitoci da sauran su don ganowa da haɓaka abubuwan da suka dace.
Northern Sotho: Tshedimošo ye e lego gona ya bohlatse bja makgonthe bjo bo beakantšwego bja go ba gona ga SARS-CoV-2 ya motheo le dinyakišišo tša phetetšano tša HIV e fana ka motheo go banyakišiši, bahlami ba dipholisi, dingaka le ba bangwe go utolla tshedimošo ka potlako le go ba le kwešišo ya maleba.
Amharic: ይህ ቀጣዩ ሕያው ስልታዊ ማስረጃ ካርታ የወቅቱ አንደኛ ደረጃ የሳርስ-ኮቫ-2 እና የኤችአይቪ የጋራ- ኢንፌክሽን ምርምር ለተመራማሪዎች፣ ለፖሊሲ አውጪዎች፣ ለክሊኒክ ባለሞያዎች እና ለሌሎችም ተገቢ ግንዛቤዎችን በፍጥነት እንዲያገኙ እና እንዲገነቡ መድረክ ይከፍታል፡፡

English: Many studies done around the world show that people with HIV/AIDS who are on treatment do not experience worsened COVID-19 symptoms or outcomes.
Luganda: Okunoonyereza kungi okukoleddwa okwetooloola ensi kulaga nti abantu abalina HIV/AIDS nga bali ku bujjanjabi tebafuna bubonero bwa COVID-19 businga ku bw’abalala.
Yoruba: Ọ̀pọ̀ ìwádìí káríayé fihaǹ pé àwọn tí wọ́n ń gba ìtójú fún aàrùn HIV/ìsọdọ̀le àjesára kì í ní àmì àìsàn COVID-19 to le tàbí ní àbájade tó burú.
Zulu: Ucwaningo oluningi olwenziwe emhlabeni wonke lukhombisa ukuthi abantu abane- HIV/AIDS abadla imishanguzo ababinazoo izimpawu ze-COVID-19 ezinzima kakhulu.
Hausa: Yawancin bincike da aka yi a duniya sun nuna cewa mutanen da ke ɗauke da HIV/AIDS da ke kan jiyya ba sa fuskantar mummunan alamun COVID-19 ko sakamakonsa.
Northern Sotho: Dinyakišišo tše ntši tše di dirilwego lefaseng di laetša gore batho bao ba nago le HIV/AIDS bao ba nwago dihlare ga ba itemogele maswao goba ditlamorago tše di mpefetšego tša COVID-19.
Amharic: በአለም ዙሪያ የተደረጉ ብዙ ጥናቶች እንደሚያሳዩት በህክምና ላይ ያሉ የኤችአይቪ /ኤድስ ታማሚዎች የከፋ የኮቪድ-19 ምልክቶች ወይም ውጤቶች ሰለባ አይሆኑም፡፡

English: Researchers who reviewed the current scientific studies available on this subject say the evidence shows HIV patients may be treated for COVID-19 like any other patient.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza abeekenneenyezza okunoonyereza kw’ekinnasaayansi okuggya okuliwo ku nsonga eno bagamba nti obukakafu bulaga nti abalwadde ba HIV bayinza okujjanjabwa COVID-19 ng’abalwadde abalala bonna.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí tí wọ́n ṣẹ àgbéyẹ̀wó àwọn ìwádìí ìjìnlẹ̀ sáyẹ́nsì tó wà lọ́wọ́lọ́wọ́ lórí kókó-ọ̀rọ̀ yìí sọ pé ẹ̀rí fihàn pé àwọn aláìsàn HIV lè gbá ìtọ́jú àrun COVID-19 gẹ́gẹ́ bí i àwọn aláìsàn mìíràn náà ti lè gbà á.
Zulu: Abacwaingi ababheke ucwaningo lwamanje lwesayensi lwalesi sihloko olukhona bathi ubufakazi bukhombisa ukuthi iziguli ze-HIV zingalashelwa i-COVID-19 njengezinye iziguli.
Hausa: Masu binciken da suka sake nazarin binciken kimiyya na yanzu da ake samu kan wannan batun sun ce shaidar ta nuna ana iya kula da masu cutar HIV don COVID-19 kamar kowane mara lafiya.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši bao ba lekodišitšego dinyakišišo tša saense tše di hwetšagalago gabjale mabapi le hlogonyakišišo ye ba bolela gore bohlatse bo laetša gore balwetši ba HIV ba ka hwetša kalafo ya COVID-19 go swana le molwetši yo mongwe le yo mongwe.
Amharic: በአሁኑ ጊዜ በዚህ ርእሰ ጉዳይ ላይ ያሉ ሳይንሳዊ ጥናቶችን የገመገሙት ተመራማሪዎች እንደሚሉት፣ የኤችአይቪ ታማሚዎች እንደማንኛውም ህምመተኛ ለኮቪድ-19 ህክምና ማግኘት እንደሚችሉ መረጃዎቹ ይጠቁማሉ፡፡

English: Because people with HIV have weakened immune systems, researchers were concerned that they may suffer more severe illness and death during the COVID-19 pandemic.
Luganda: Olw’okuba ng’abantu abalina HIV babeera n’amaanyi matono agalwanyisa endwadde, abanoonyereza baali balowooza nti bayinza okulwala ennyo oba okufa okusinga ku balala mu kiseera kya nawookeera wa COVID-19.
Yoruba: Nítorí ètò àjesára àwọn alárùn HIV kò ní agbára tó, àwọn aṣèwádìí lẹ́rò pé wọ́n lè ní àìsàn tó burú jù tabi kú lasìkò àjàkáyé aàrùn COVID-19.
Zulu: Ngenxa yokuthi abantu abane-HIV banamasosha omzimba abuthaka. abacwaningi bebekhathazwa ukuthi bengagula kakhulu futhi bafe ngenxa yempathamhlaba i-COVID-19.
Hausa: Saboda mutanen da ke ɗauke da HIV sun raunana tsarin rigakafi, masu bincike sun damu cewa za su iya fama da rashin lafiya da mutuwa yayin cutar ta COVID-19.
Northern Sotho: Ka lebaka la gore batho bao ba nago le HIV ba na le mašole a mmele ao a fokolago, banyakišiši ba be ba tshwenyegile gore ba ka hlaselwa ke malwetši a šoro kudu le lehu nakong ya leuba la COVID-19.
Amharic: የኤችአይቪ ታማሚዎች የደከመ የበሽታ መከላከያ ስርዓቶች ስላሏቸው በኮቪድ-19 ወረርሽኝ ጊዜ ለከፋ ህመም እና ሞት ሊዳረጉ ይችላሉ ብለው ሰግተው ነበር፡፡

English: By looking at individual studies about how HIV/AIDS patients respond to COVID-19 infection and treatments, researchers hoped to draw general conclusions to help other researchers, governments and doctors decide how to treat HIV/AIDS patients who are also infected with COVID-19.
Luganda: Nga batunuulira okunoonyereza okw’enjawulo ku ngeri abalwadde ba HIV/AIDS gye bayisibwamu COVID-19 n’obujjanjabi bwe, abanoonyereza baali basuubira okukola okusalawo okw’awamu okuyamba abanoonyereza abalala, zigavumenti n’abasawo okusalawo engeri y’okujjanjabamu abalwadde ba HIV/AIDS abalina ne COVID-19.
Yoruba: Nípa wíwo àwọn ìwádìí ìjìnlẹ̀ tí àwọn enìyàn tí ṣe lórí bí àwọn alárùn HIV/AIDS ṣe ń dáhùn sí ìkóràn àti ìtọ́jú COVID-19, àwọn aṣèwádìí ní ìrètí láti ran àwọn aṣèwádìí mìíràn, ìjọba àti àwọn oníṣègùn òyìnbó lọ́wọ́ bí wọ́n ṣelè ṣe ìtójú àwọn aláìsàn àti HIV àti ìsọdọ̀le àjesára tí wọ́n tún ní ìkóràn COVID-19.
Zulu: Ngokubheka ucwaningo olubheka ukuthi iziguli ezine-HIV/AIDS iziphatha kanjani i-COVID-19 nemithi yayo, abacwaningi bebefisa ukukhipha iziphetho ezizosiza abanye abacwaningi, ohulumeni nodokotela benqume ukuthi bazozihlenga kanjani iziguli ze-HIV/AIDS eziphethwe i-COVID-19.
Hausa: Ta hanyar duban binciken mutum game da yadda masu cuta mai karya garkuwan jiki/qanjamau HIV/AIDS ke amsawa ga kamuwa da cutar COVID-19 da jiyya, masu binciken sun yi fatan zana gamayya don taimakawa sauran masu bincike, gwamnatoci da likitoci su yanke shawarar yadda za a bi da masu cutar HIV/AIDS waɗanda su ma suka kamu da COVID-19.
Northern Sotho: Ka go lebelela dinyakišišo tšeo di dirilwego ke batho mabapi le ka moo balwetši ba HIV/AIDS ba ikarabelago go phetetšo ya COVID-19 le dikalafo, banyakišiši ba be ba na le tshepho ya go fihlelela sephetho go thuša banyakišiši ba bangwe, mebušo le dingaka go tšea sephetho mabapi le ka moo ba ka alafago balwetši ba HIV/AIDS bao ba fetetšwego le ke COVID-19.
Amharic: የኤችአይቪ/ኤድስ ታማሚዎች ለኮቪድ-19 ኢንፌክሽን ህክምናዎች ምን አይነት ምላሽ እምደሚሰጡ የሚዳስሱ ግላዊ ጥናቶችን በማየት ተማራማሪዎቹ ሌሎች ተመራማሪዎች፣ መንግስታት እና ዶክተሮች በኮቪድ-19 የተበከሉ የኤችአይቪ/ኤድስ ተማማዎች እንዴት መታከም እንዳለባቸው አጠቃለይ ውሳኔ እንዲወስዱ ያግዛቸዋል ብለው ተስፋ ያደርጋሉ፡፡

English: They looked through research papers containing keywords like “HIV”, “AIDS”, “Coronavirus” and “COVID-19”, released between January and June, 2020.
Luganda: Baatunula mu mpapula z’okunoonyereza ezirimu ebigambo ebikulu nga “HIV”, “AIDS”, “Coronavirus” ne “COVID-19”, ezaafulumizibwa wakati wa Janwali n’Ogwomukaaga, 2020.
Yoruba: Áwọn aṣèwádìí wo àwọn ìwé tó jáde láàárín oṣù Ṣẹẹrẹ àti oṣù Agẹmọ, ọdún 2020 tó kún fún àwọn kókó-ọ̀rọ̀ bí i "HIV', "AIDS", kòró" àti COVID-19.
Zulu: Babheke amaphepha ocwaningo anamagama athi “HIV”, “AIDS”, “Coronavirus” no “COVID-19”, ashicilelwe phakathi kukaMasingana(Januwari) noNhlangulana(June), ku-2020.
Hausa: Sun bincika takaddun bincike masu ɗauke da kalmomi kamar "HIV", "AIDS", "Coronavirus" da "COVID-19", waɗanda aka saki tsakanin Janairu da Yuni, 2020.
Northern Sotho: Ba lekodišišitše dingwalwa tša dinyakišišo tše di nago le mantšu a bohlokwa a bjalo ka “HIV”, “AIDS”, “Coronavirus” le “COVID-19”, tše di phatlaladitšwego magareng ga Janaware le June, 2020.
Amharic: ”ኤችአይቪ“ “ኤድስ” ”ኮሮና ቫይረስ“ እና “ኮቪድ-19“ አይነት ቁልፍ ቃላትን የያዙ እና በጃንዋሪ እና በጁን፣ 2020 መካከል የተለቀቁ የምርምር ወረቀቶችን ዳሰዋል፡፡

English: The researchers were specifically looking for reports about HIV positive individuals, or people with AIDS, who were on antiretroviral treatments and had tested positive for COVID-19.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza okusinga baanoonya alipoota ku bantu abalina HIV, oba abantu abalina AIDS, abaali ku ddagala eriweweeza HIV era nga baali basangiddwa ne COVID-19.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí ń wá àbọ̀ nípa àwọn aláìsàn HIV, tàbí àwọn aláìsàn ìsọdọ̀le àjesára tí wọn lo oògùn adènà HIV tí wọ́n sì ní àìsàn COVID-19.
Zulu: Abacwaningi benebheka imibiko yabane-HIV, noma abane-AIDS, abebedla imishanguzo batholakala bene-COVID-19.
Hausa: Masu binciken suna neman takamaiman rahotanni game da masu ɗauke da HIV, ko mutanen da ke da HIV, waɗanda ke kan maganin rigakafin cutar AIDS kuma sun gwada ingancin COVID-19.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba be ba nyakana le dipego tše di bolelago ka batho bao ba nago le phetetšo ya HIV, goba batho bao ba nago le AIDS, bao ba bego ba šomiša dihlare tša anthiretherobaerale gomme diteko tša bona di laeditše gore ba na le bolwetši bja COVID-19.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ  በተለይ የጸረ-ኤችአይቪ ህክምና እየወሰዱ ያሉ እና በኮቪድ-19 አውንታዊ የህክምና ውጤት ያገኙ በኤችአይቪ የተያዙ ግለሰቦች ወይም ኤድስ ያለባቸው ሰዎች ላይ የተደረጉ ዘገባዎችን ሲፈልጉ ነበር፡፡

English: From their search, the researchers found 35 papers from 13 countries, with the first case of COVID-19 and HIV co-infection reported in China.
Luganda: Mu kunoonya kwabwe, abanoonyereza baazuula empapula 35 okuva mu mawanga 13, ng’omuntu eyasooka okukwatibwa COVID-19 ne HIV yali mu China.
Yoruba: Nínú èsì ìwádìí wọn, àwọn aṣèwádìí rí ìwé 35 láti orílẹ̀-èdè 13, pẹ̀lú ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ ìkóràn-oníbejì COVID-19 àti HIV àkọ́kọ́ ní orìlẹ̀-èdè China.
Zulu: Kulokhu abebekuphenya, abacaningi abthole amaphepha awu-35 avela emazweni awu-13, umbiko wokuqala wokuba ne-COVID-19 ne-HIV kanyekanye wabikwa eShayina.
Hausa: Daga binciken da suka yi, masu binciken sun gano takardu 35 daga kasashe 13, tare da bullar cutar COVID-19 na farko da cutar HIV a ƙasar Sin.
Northern Sotho: Go tšwa go masolo a bona a go nyaka tshedimošo, banyakišiši ba hweditše dingwalwa tše 35 go tšwa dinageng tše 13, tše di bilego le bolwetši bja mathomo bja COVID-19 le go fetelwa gape ke HIV tše di begilwego go la China.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ ከፍለጋቸው  ከ13 ሃገራት 35 ወረቀቶችን ያገኙ ሲሆን፣ የመጀመሪያው የኮቪድ 19-እና የኤችአይቪ የጋራ-ኢንፌክሽን ሪፖርት የተደረገው ቻይና ውስጥ ነበር፡፡

English: They found that HIV/AIDS does not appear to make COVID-19 disease worse, and that newly diagnosed HIV patients mostly recovered from COVID-19.
Luganda: Baakizuula nti HIV/AIDS tafaanana kufuula bulwadde bwa COVID-19 bwa mutawaana, era nti abalwadde abaakazuulibwamu HIV bangi baawona COVID-19.
Yoruba: Wọ́n rí i pé aàrùn HIV/AIDS kì í jẹ kí aàrùn COVID-19 kó burú sí I, àti wí pé àwọn tí wọ́n ṣẹ̀ṣẹ̀ ní aàrùn HIV máa ń bọ̀sípò lá tàrí COVID-19.
Zulu: Bathole ukuthi i-HIV/AIDS ayenzi ukuthi i-COVID-19 ibe yimbi kakhulu, nokuthi abaningi abasanda kuthola ukuthi bane-HIV basheshe basinda kwi-COVID-19.
Hausa: Sun gano cewa cuta mai karya garkuwan jiki/qanjamau HIV/AIDS kamar ba ya sa cutar ta COVID-19 ta yi muni, kuma sabbin masu cutar HIV da aka gano galibi sun murmure daga COVID-19.
Northern Sotho: Ba hweditše gore HIV/AIDS ga e laetše e gakatša bolwetši bja COVID-19, le gore bontši bja balwetši bao ba sa tšwago go phekolwa ka HIV ba kgonne go fola bolwetšing bja COVID-19.
Amharic: ኤችአይቪ/ኤድስ የኮቪድ-19 በሽታን የሚያባብስ እንደማይመስል አስተውለዋል፤ እና አዲስ የተመረመሩ የኤችአይቪ  ታማሚዎችም ከኮቪድ-19 ያገገሙ መሆኑን ደርሰውበታል፡፡

English: The researchers also found that the patients had common COVID-19 symptoms like cough, fever, shortness of breath, fatigue, loss of smell and taste, and diarrhoea.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza era baakizuula nti abalwadde baalina obubonero bwa COVID-19 obwa bulijjo ng’okukolola, okubulwa omukka, ekimenyoomenyo, obutawunyiriza n’okufa akamwa, n’ekiddukano.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí náà ri pé àwọn aláìsàn yìí náà máa ń ni àmì àìsàn COVID-19 tí ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ máa ń ni bi i ikọ́, ibà, àìlèmí dáadáa, rírẹ̀, àìlègbóòórùn àti àìlètọ́wò, àti ìgbẹ́ gbuuru.
Zulu: Laba bacwaningi baphinde bathola ukuthi iziguli bezinezimpawu ze-COVID-19 ezivamile njengo kukhwehlela, imfiva, ukuphelelwa umoya, ukukhathala, ukuphelelwa izinzwa zokunuka nokuzwa emlonyeni, nesifo sohudo.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun kuma gano cewa majinyatan suna da alamun COVID-19 gama gari kamar tari, zazzavi, gajeriyar numfashi, gajiya, rasa jin wari da xanxano, da gudawa.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba utollotše gape gore balwetši ba bile le maswao ao a tlwaelegilego a COVID-19 a bjalo ka go gohlola, phišo ya mmele, go felelwa ke moya wa go hema, go lapa kudu, go se kwe monkgo le tatso, le letšhollo.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ በተጨማሪ ታማሚዎቹ እንደ ሳል፣ ትኩሳት፣ የትንፋሽ ማጠር፣ ድካም፣ የማሽተት እና የጣእም ማጣት እና ተቅማጥ የመሰሉ የተለመዱ የኮቪድ-19 ምልክቶች እንደነበራቸው አግኝተዋል፡፡

English: Only one patient had seizures.
Luganda: Omulwadde omu yekka ye yafuna okwesika.
Yoruba: Aláìsàn kan ni ó ṣe dákú-dájí.
Zulu: Isigulu esisodwa kuphela esibe nokuquleka.
Hausa: Majiyyaci xaya ne kawai ya kamu da daskarewar jiki.
Northern Sotho: Ke molwetši o tee fela yo a bilego le bolwetši bja go wa.
Amharic: አንድ ታማሚ ብቻ እንፍርፍሪት ነበረው፡፡

English: In general, HIV/AIDS individuals seem to respond to COVID-19 just like any other patient.
Luganda: Okutwaliza awamu, abantu abalina HIV/AIDS balabika nga COVID-19 abayisa kyekimu ng’abalwadde abalala bonna.
Yoruba: Ní àkótán, àwọn aláìsàn HIV/AIDS máa ń ní dáhùn sí COVID-19 gẹ́gẹ̀ bi àwọn aláìsàn mìíràn.
Zulu: Ngokujwayelekile, abane-HIV/AIDS baphathwa i-COVID-19 njengazo zonke iziguli.
Hausa: Gabaɗaya, da alama mutane masu cuta mai karya garkuwar jiki/qanjamau HIV/AIDS suna kamuwa da COVID-19 kamar kowane mara lafiya.
Northern Sotho: Ka kakaretšo, balwetši ba HIV/AIDS ba laetša ba ikarabela go COVID-19 go swana le molwetši yo mongwe le yo mongwe.
Amharic: በጥቅሉ የኤችአይቪ/ኤድስ ታማሚዎች ለኮቪድ-19 እንደማንኛውም ሌላ በሽተኛ አይነት ምላሽ የመስጠት አዝማሚያ አላቸው፡፡

English: However, COVID-19 risk increased only when patients had other diseases like hypertension, diabetes, obesity and kidney disease.
Luganda: Wabula, obulabe bwa COVID-19 bweyongera mu balwadde bokka abaalina endwadde endala nga puleesa, sukaali, omugejjo n’obulwadde bw’ensigo.
Yoruba: Wàyí, ewu COVID-19 máa ń pọ̀ nínú àwọn tó ní àìsàn bí i ìfúnpá, ìtọ̀-ṣúgà, sísanrà jù, aàrùn kíndìnrín.
Zulu: Nokho ke, ubungozi bokuthola i-COVID-19 kunyuke uma iziguli bezinezinye izifo njengephika, isifo sashukela, ukuba mkhulu ngokweqile nesifo sezinso.
Hausa: Koyaya, haɗarin COVID-19 ya ƙaru ne kawai lokacin da marasa lafiya ke da wasu cututtuka kamar hauhawar jini, ciwon sukari, qiba da cutar qoda.
Northern Sotho: Le ge go le bjalo, kotsi ya COVID-19 e oketšegile fela ge balwetši ba bile le malwetši a mangwe a bjalo ka haephathenšene, twetšiswikiri, mmele o montši le bolwetši bja dipshio.
Amharic: ነገር ግን፣ የኮቪድ-19 አደጋ የሚጨምረው ታማሚዎቹ እነደ ከፍተኛ የደም ግፊት፣ ስኳር፣ ከልክ ያለፈ ውፍረት እና የኩላሊት በሽታ አይነት ሌሎች በሽታዎች ተጠቂ ሲሆኑ ብቻ ነው፡፡

English: The researchers also report that the HIV/AIDS drug, darunavir, does not prevent Coronavirus infection.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza era bagamba nti eddagala lya HIV/AIDS, darunavir, teriziyiza kufuna Coronavirus.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí jabọ̀ pé oògùn HIV/iAIDS, darunavir, kì í pa dẹ́kun ìkóràn kòró.
Zulu: Abacwaningi babika nokuthi umshanguzo we- HIV/AIDS, i-darunavir, ayikuvimbi ukuphathwa ukhuvethe.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun kuma bayar da rahoton cewa maganin cutar HIV/AIDS, darunavir, ba ya hana kamuwa da cutar Coronavirus.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba bega le gore sehlare sa HIV/AIDS, e lego darunavir, ga se thibele phetetšo ya Coronavirus.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ በተጨማሪ የኤችአይቪ/ኤድስ መድሃኒት የሆነው ዳሩናቪር የኮሮና ቫይረስ ኢንፌክሽንን እንደማይከላከል ደርሰውበታል፡፡

English: Their search also revealed that co-infected patients who had kidney and liver transplants also recovered from COVID-19.
Luganda: Okunoonyereza kwabwe era kwalaga nti abalwadde abaalina obuwuka bwombi nga baali bakyusiddwa ensigo n’ekibumba nabo baawona COVID-19.
Yoruba: Ìwádìí wọn tún fihàn pé láìsàn o ní ìkóràn-oníbejì tó ti ṣe ìfidípò kíndìnrín àti ẹ̀dọ̀ lẹ̀ bọ́sípò látàrí COVID-19.
Zulu: Uphenyo lwabo luveze ukuthi iziguli eziphethwe yikho kokubili abake bafakwa izinso nezibindi basindile kwi-COVID-19.
Hausa: Binciken nasu ya kuma nuna cewa majinyatan da suka kamu da cutar tare da dashen koda da hanta suma sun murmure daga COVID-19.
Northern Sotho: Diphatišišo tša bona di utollotše le gore balwetši ba ba phelago ka malwetši a mantši bao ba dirilwego dipšalollo tša pshio goba sebete le bona ba fodile bolwetšing bja COVID-19.
Amharic: ፍለጋቸው እንዳረጋገጠው፣  የኩላሊት እና የጉበት ንቅለ ተከላ የነበራቸው በጋራ-ኢንፌክሽን የተጠቁ ታማሚዎች ከኮቪድ-19 አገግምዋል፡፡

English: The researchers caution that their conclusions may be biassed because they only found studies written in English.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza balabula nti bye baazuula biyinza okubaamu kyekubiira olw’okuba nga baafuna kunoonyereza kwokka okuwandiikiddwa mu Lungereza.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí kìlọ̀ pé ó ṣe é ṣe kí àyọrísí ìwádìí wọn fì sí ibì kan ìdí ni pé èdè Gẹ̀ẹ́sì ni wọ́n fi kọ àwọn ìwé tí wọ́n rí.
Zulu: Abacwaningi baxwayisa ukuthi iziphetho zabo zingama nganxanye ngoba bathole ucwaningo olubhalwe ngesiNgisi kuphela.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun yi gargadin cewa ra'ayinsu na iya zama rashin son zuciya saboda kawai sun sami rubuce-rubucen da aka rubuta cikin Ingilishi.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba lemoša gore dikutollo tša bona di ka ba di tšea lehlakore ka gore ba hweditše fela dinyakišišo tše di ngwadilwego ka Seisimane.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ ማግኘት የቻሉት በእንጊሊዘኛ የተጻፉ ጥናቶችን ብቻ ስለሆነ መደምደሚያቸው ወገንተኛ ሊሆን እንደሚችል አስጠንቅቀዋል፡፡

English: They recommend further studies on how COVID-19 interacts with other diseases like tuberculosis, and pneumonia, and how co-infections can affect patients’ mental health.
Luganda: Bateesa nti okunoonyereza okulala kukolebwe ku ngeri COVID-19 gy’akolaganamu n’endwadde endala nga akafuba, ne lubyamira, n’engeri okuba n’obuwuka buno bwombi gye kisobola okukosaamu obwongo bw’omulwadde.
Yoruba: Wọ́n tẹ̀síwájú sí I nínú ìwádìí ìjìnlẹ̀ wọn láti jẹ́ kí a mọ bí COVID-19 ṣẹ ń ṣiṣẹ́ pẹ̀lú àwọn aàrùn mìíràn bi i ikọ́ ife, àti òtútù àyà, àti bí ìkóràn-oníbẹjì ṣẹ lè fa àìsàn ọpọlọ fún aláìsàn.
Zulu: Bayala ukuthi kuqhutshekwe kwenziwe olunye ucwaningo ngendlela i-COVID-19 esebenzisana nezinye izifo ezifna nesifo sofuba, nenyumoniya, nokuthi izifo eziphathana ngokuhambisana zingaba namthelela muni empilweni yengqondo yeziguli.
Hausa: Suna ba da shawarar ƙarin nazari kan yadda COVID-19 ke hulɗa da wasu cututtuka kamar tarin fuka, da ciwon huhu, da kuma yadda cututtukan haɗin gwiwa na iya shafar lafiyar kwakwalwar marasa lafiya.
Northern Sotho: Ba šišinya gore go dirwe dinyakišišo tše dingwe mabapi le ka moo COVID-19 e amanago le malwetši a mangwe a go swana le bolwetši bja mafahla, le nyumonia, le ka moo go phela ka malwetši a mantši go ka amago go phelega gabotse monaganong ga balwetši.
Amharic: ኮቪድ-19 እንዴት ሳንባነቀርሳ እና የሳንባ ምች  ከመሳሰሉ ሌሎች በሽታዎች ጋር እንደሚገናኝ እና የጋራ-ኢንፌክሽኖች የታማሚዎች የስነልቦና ጤንነት ላይ እንዴት ተጽእኖ እንደሚኖራቸው ተጨማሪ ምርምሮች እንዲደረጉ ይመክራሉ፡፡

English: This review was compiled by researchers from South Africa, where HIV/AIDS remains a massive health burden.
Luganda: Okwekenneenya kuno kwakolebwa abanoonyereza okuva mu South Afirika, ekizibu kya HIV/AIDS gye kikyali eky’amaanyi.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwadìí orílẹ̀-èdè South Africa, ní bi ti aàrùn HIV/AIDS jẹ́ ìṣòro ìlera tó kọni lóminú jù.
Zulu: Lolu hlahlelo luhlanganiswe abacwaningi base Ningizimu Afrika, lapho i-HIV/AIDS isawumthwalo kwezempilo.
Hausa: Masu bincike daga Afirka ta Kudu ne suka tattara wannan bita, inda cuta mai karya garkuwar jiki/qanjamau HIV/AIDS ta kasance babban matsala ga kiwon lafiya.
Northern Sotho: Tekodišišo ye e hlophilwe ke banyakišiši go tšwa Afrika Borwa, moo HIV/AIDS e phelago e le morwalo o boima go maphelo.
Amharic: ይሄ ግምገማ የተጠናቀረው ኤችአይቪ/ኤድስ ከፍተኛ የጤና ሸክም በሆነበት በደቡብ አፍሪካ ተመራማሪዎች ነው፡፡
